item.title: Said & Checked, Banking and Finance, 2026-11-15: none false or contradicted, 1 unsupported (Mike Pence)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported

  • Mike Pence, Former Vice President of the United States: “And the fact that, that a large portion of the source of that, before the inauguration, came from foreign interests in the Arab world.” Unsupported. No financial disclosure or official record was found showing what share of the family's cryptocurrency proceeds before the inauguration came from investors in Arab countries. The search covered token sales before the inauguration, a $2 billion deal with an Abu Dhabi firm that was announced after it, and the warehouse catalog; a Reuters report could not be read.

1 statement by 1 officeholder. 1 checked: 1 unsupported · 0 not checkable.
